coordinateNotes.u_v: normalized position on the FULL equirectangular image: u 0->1 left->right (0.5 = image centre = yaw 0 = plan up); v 0.68 (the viewer draws interior door markers on its floor rows)
coordinateNotes.plan: x/y in the pixel space of plan/floorplan.webp = the sales-sheet crop x 0.5 (sheet px = plan_meta.origin_px + cm x scale_px_per_cm)
coordinateNotes.hotspots: u from the plan bearing camera -> the opening between the two rooms (plan.json openings), or the straight way to the target camera in the open plan; computed by tools/tour360/make_apartment.py, not by eye
coordinateNotes.heading: the start yaw = the bearing of plan.json cameras[].look (the view the panorama was composed for)
